titles.a: Barcelona Lost Once In 13 Games. Is The La Liga Title Race Already Over?
titles.b: Can Real Madrid Catch Barcelona? 36 Points To 33

intro: After 13 La Liga games Barcelona have 36 points, Real Madrid 33 and Atlético Madrid 31. This video goes through the table, Barcelona's one defeat (the Clásico on 25 October), the three wins since, the comeback against Villarreal, the top scorers, the Champions League record and the fixtures ahead, using only what the cited pages say. No tactical or offside numbers are used because none could be verified.
disclaimer: Figures are from Wikipedia's 2026-27 La Liga table after 13 matches, Wikipedia's 2026-27 FC Barcelona season page, and match reports from Khelnow and The Daily Star (22 November 2026). The video does not predict the title. Match clips are LALIGA EA SPORTS highlights, short, muted and used with commentary; the owner and the match are named on screen. Photos are from Wikimedia Commons under Creative Commons licences, credited in this description.
